question: When was the first Session of the Lok Sabha of independent India held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**13th May 1952.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Lok Sabha:-**

 
 
• It​ is the **lower house **of the Indian Parliament.
 
• The **first Lok Sabha **was constituted on 17th April 195
